## WooCommerce & WordPress Plugin 1-Star Churn Monitor (Zero-Key)

Queries the official **WordPress.org Plugins API v1.2** (`api.wordpress.org`) plus live **1-star review RSS feeds** (`?filter=1`) to surface high-install plugins leaking dissatisfied users (pricing/billing friction, update breakage, unresolved support tickets).

### Optional Scale & AI / MCP Integrations (MIT)
- **Hosted Agent Skill:** https://www.agensi.io/skills/wordpress-woocommerce-plugin-churn-spy
- **STDIO MCP Server:** `npx -y github:truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-mcp`
- **Python 3.10+ SDK:** https://github.com/truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-python
- **Cloud Batch ($5/mo free tier):** https://apify.com/ttyan0111
